title: 2013 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 1
statement: A standard 52 -card deck contains cards of 4 suits and 13 numbers, with exactly one card for each pairing of suit and number. If Maya draws two cards with replacement from this deck, what is the probability that the two cards have the same suit or have the same number, but not both?

solutions.text: \(\quad \frac{15}{52}\) After drawing the first card, there are 12 other cards from the same suit and 3 other cards with the same number, so the probability is \(\frac{12+3}{52}\).
